name: RepoZero
rai:dataLimitations: RepoZero covers two code translation categories (C2Rust and Py2JS) and may not generalize to other programming languages or translation paradigms.
rai:dataBiases: The benchmark focuses on specific open-source libraries; performance may vary on code from different domains or coding styles not represented in the selected repositories.
rai:personalSensitiveInformation: No personal or sensitive information is included. All data is derived from open-source code repositories.
rai:dataUseCases: Intended for benchmarking and evaluating code translation capabilities of large language models, specifically C++ to Rust and Python to JavaScript translation tasks.
rai:dataSocialImpact: RepoZero supports research in automated code migration, which can reduce manual effort in modernizing legacy codebases and improving software security.
